cohort: 78 pregnant women with complete placenta previa, with uterine EA activity recorded from 32 to 34 weeks of gestation
finding: Women with complete placenta previa have higher uterine EA at 32-34 weeks of gestation, which is associated with a higher risk of preterm CS due to massive vaginal bleeding.
mod_finding: Women with complete placenta previa have higher uterine electrical activity at 32-34 weeks of gestation and this is associated with a higher risk of preterm cesarean section due to massive vaginal bleeding.
